issues.title: Create button enabled while required Project name field is empty

quote.text: Is this the plus button to start my project?

issues.why: The Create button is active before the user enters a project name, allowing a submission that likely fails validation silently. This contributes to the silent failure observed in the critical issue above.

fix.summary: Disable Create button until Project name has a non-whitespace value; enable only when required fields are valid.
fix.before: Create button is enabled on dialog open with empty Project name and Project key fields.
fix.after: Create button is disabled until Project name contains at least one non-whitespace character; Project key validated per format rules.

issues.title: Payment details required before account creation despite free trial

quote.text: Filling in my details to create the account.

issues.why: The signup form asks for credit card information (card number, expiry, CVC) before the user can submit, even though the plan is advertised as a 14-day free trial. This adds friction and may cause abandonment before account creation.

fix.summary: Remove payment fields from the initial signup form; collect payment details only after the free trial ends or when the user explicitly chooses to upgrade.
fix.before: Signup form includes Card number, Expiry, and CVC fields that must be filled before Submit is clicked.
fix.after: Signup form collects only name, email, password, workspace slug, and terms consent; payment details are requested later in the billing settings or at trial conversion.

issues.title: Project creation fails silently with no feedback

quote.text: Nothing I do here seems to work. I'm done.

issues.why: After filling in project details and clicking Create, the screen does not change, show a loading state, display an error, or navigate to the project. Users repeat the action multiple times before giving up.

fix.summary: Add immediate feedback on Create click: disable button, show spinner, then navigate to project or show inline validation error if submission fails.
fix.before: Clicking Create does nothing visible; button stays enabled and page remains static.
fix.after: Clicking Create disables the button, shows a loading indicator, and either redirects to the new project or displays a specific error message if the request fails.

issues.title: Project key field has no label, placeholder, or format guidance

quote.text: I hope HLBF works for Hometown Library Book Fair.

issues.why: Users must guess the purpose and format of the Project key field. Margaret invented an abbreviation, while others left it blank or entered duplicate values, increasing the chance of validation errors that are not surfaced.

fix.summary: Add a clear label and placeholder to the Project key field explaining its purpose and format.
fix.before: Input with no label or placeholder (element 9).
fix.after: Label: Project key; Placeholder: e.g. HLBF (2-6 uppercase letters, used in task IDs)

issues.title: Submit button enabled while Terms of Service checkbox is unchecked
issues.why: Users can click Submit without checking the required Terms of Service checkbox, causing a failed submission that provides no clear error message. Diego, Kofi, Margaret, and Nadia all had to notice and check the box manually.

fix.summary: Disable Submit button until the Terms of Service checkbox is checked; enable it only when all required fields and consents are valid.
fix.before: Submit button is enabled while the Terms of Service checkbox is unchecked.
fix.after: Submit button remains disabled until the user checks the Terms of Service checkbox and all required fields are filled.

expert.screen_label: Projects that stay on track, without the busywork
expert.finding: The cookie consent banner at the bottom left covers the page content and primary call-to-action, blocking users from seeing or interacting with the signup flow.
expert.suggestion: Move the cookie banner to a non-blocking position or make it dismissible before users reach the main content.

expert.finding: The payment details section requires credit card information before the user can create an account, despite offering a 14-day free trial.
expert.suggestion: Make payment details optional during signup and only collect them before the trial ends or when upgrading to a paid plan.

expert.finding: The 'Create' button is enabled while the 'Project name' field is empty, giving no indication that the field is required and likely causing a failed submission.
expert.suggestion: Disable the 'Create' button until a project name is entered, or show inline validation when the field is blank.

expert.finding: The Submit button is enabled even though the Terms of Service checkbox is unchecked, allowing users to attempt submission and fail.
expert.suggestion: Disable the Submit button until the Terms of Service checkbox is checked.

expert.screen_label: Projects that stay on track, without the busywork
expert.finding: The page title says 'Fernhill · Project planning for small teams' but the visible heading and context describe a marketing homepage, creating confusion about whether this is actually the signup page users intended.
expert.suggestion: Update the page title and heading to clearly indicate this is the signup or landing page for creating a first project.

expert.screen_label: Pick the plan that fits your team
expert.finding: The 'Monthly' toggle appears selected but the page does not visually indicate that the displayed prices are monthly versus yearly, so users cannot confirm which billing mode is active.
expert.suggestion: Add a clear visual indicator (e.g., highlighted state or label) showing the active billing cycle and update prices when toggled.

expert.screen_label: Pick the plan that fits your team
expert.finding: The 'Start free trial' links do not state the plan price or user limit before signup, so users may commit to a plan without confirming it matches their needs.
expert.suggestion: Include the plan price and key limits directly on each 'Start free trial' link or button.

expert.finding: The card number, expiry, and CVC fields display placeholder text (1234 5678 9012 3456, MM/YY, 123) that remains visible and could be mistaken for actual values or example data to copy.
expert.suggestion: Remove the placeholder text from payment fields or use clearly labeled example formatting that disappears on focus.

expert.finding: The Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links in the consent checkbox use '#' as their href, so they do not navigate anywhere when clicked.
expert.suggestion: Replace the '#' hrefs with actual URLs or modal triggers so users can read the policies before agreeing.

expert.finding: The sidebar link "Inbox" shows a badge with the number 2, but there is no indication of what the new items are or how to clear the notification.
expert.suggestion: Add a tooltip or a small legend explaining the badge, or highlight the unread inbox items when the user navigates to Inbox.

expert.finding: There are three separate "+ Add task" buttons (one in each Kanban column) plus an "Invite teammates" button, creating redundant and inconsistent entry points for adding tasks.
expert.suggestion: Use a single, globally placed primary action button for adding tasks, and remove the per-column duplicates to reduce visual clutter.

expert.finding: The 'Getting started' panel shows 'Create your account' as checked but provides no confirmation or feedback that the account setup is actually complete.
expert.suggestion: Add a clear success message or visual confirmation that the account has been created.

expert.finding: The empty state instructs users to 'Click + next to Projects in the sidebar' but the sidebar 'PROJECTS' section shows 'No projects' with no visible plus button adjacent to it, making the instruction impossible to follow.
expert.suggestion: Add a visible plus button next to the 'PROJECTS' heading in the sidebar, or change the instruction to point to the central '+' button in the empty state card.

expert.finding: The 'Project key' textbox has no label, placeholder, or format guidance, so users do not know what value to enter.
expert.suggestion: Add a placeholder such as 'e.g. WEBSITE' or helper text explaining the expected format.

expert.finding: The Workspace slug field shows a partial URL prefix 'fernhill.app/' inside the input, making it unclear what portion the user should type.
expert.suggestion: Move the 'fernhill.app/' prefix outside the input as static text so the user types only the slug.

expert.finding: The 'Getting started' panel shows 'Create your account' as complete with a checkmark, but the user is already signed in as Diego, making the step misleading and confusing.
expert.suggestion: Remove or relabel the completed account step so the onboarding list reflects only remaining actions.

expert.finding: The central empty-state card instructs users to 'Click + next to Projects in the sidebar' but the visible sidebar has no 'Projects' label adjacent to a plus button, so users cannot locate the control.
expert.suggestion: Update the instruction to match the actual UI, such as 'Click the + button under PROJECTS in the sidebar'.

expert.screen_label: Projects that stay on track, without the busywork
expert.finding: Multiple 'Get started' links (IDs 7, 8, 10) all point to pricing.html instead of a signup or registration page, which is inconsistent with the user goal of signing up.
expert.suggestion: Change the primary 'Get started' buttons to link to a signup or account creation page rather than pricing.

expert.screen_label: Projects that stay on track, without the busywork
expert.finding: The footer contains numerous placeholder links (Guides, About, Careers, Status, Contact) that go to '#', which may frustrate users expecting real destinations.
expert.suggestion: Replace placeholder '#' links with actual URLs or remove them until they are functional.

expert.screen_label: Pick the plan that fits your team
expert.finding: The top navigation 'Pricing' link is marked as selected, but the footer also contains a 'Pricing' link with no selected state, creating inconsistent navigation cues.
expert.suggestion: Apply the same selected styling to the footer 'Pricing' link or remove the selected state from the top nav to match the footer.

expert.finding: The Workspace slug field shows a static prefix 'fernhill.app/' outside the input, making it unclear whether users can edit the full URL or only the slug portion.
expert.suggestion: Place the prefix as non-editable helper text outside the field or make the entire slug editable in a single input.

expert.finding: The "Done" column is empty but still displays an "+ Add task" input, which invites users to add completed tasks directly to a done state, contradicting the workflow logic.
expert.suggestion: Hide the "+ Add task" input in the Done column or disable it until a task is moved there from another column.

expert.finding: The top navigation uses only icons for Home, My tasks, Inbox, and Reports, forcing users to rely on memory or hover to understand each icon's purpose.
expert.suggestion: Add visible text labels next to each icon in the sidebar navigation so the purpose of each link is immediately clear.

expert.finding: The 'Upgrade' link in the bottom left corner is visually emphasized as a primary action despite the user's goal being to create a project, which could lead to accidental navigation away from the signup flow.
expert.suggestion: De-emphasize the 'Upgrade' link or move it to a less prominent location to prevent accidental clicks during onboarding.

expert.finding: The 'Upgrade' link in the bottom-left corner is partially obscured by the page edge, making it hard to recognize as a clickable element.
expert.suggestion: Ensure the 'Upgrade' link is fully visible and not cut off by the container boundary.

expert.finding: The Work email textbox has no visible label, only a placeholder, so the label disappears once the user starts typing.
expert.suggestion: Add a visible 'Work email' label above the input field.

expert.finding: The page title is 'Home · Fernhill' while the main heading says 'Welcome to Fernhill, Diego', creating an inconsistent identity for the current page.
expert.suggestion: Align the browser tab title with the main heading, e.g. 'Dashboard · Fernhill'.

expert.finding: The 'Upgrade' link in the sidebar and the 'Upgrade' link in the bottom 'Free plan' banner both point to pricing.html, offering redundant paths to the same action.
expert.suggestion: Keep only one upgrade entry point or differentiate them clearly by context.
